d.t: WALL SPACER FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVERS FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Wall Spacer is an accessory to create a gap between raised pavers and the surrounding parapet wall. Wall spacers are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it has a compressible buffer to accommodate the expansion and contraction of materials under thermal influence. SikaRoof VersiJack Wall Spacer is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack and is installed between the top of pedestals and beneath the pavers.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Wall spacer for raised paving installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.

Clean and sound surface shall have at least a wood float finish. All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure. High spots in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be cut off or ground down to prevent damage/puncture to the pedestal base.

SikaRoof VersiJack Wall Spacer shall be installed with SikaRoof VersiJack. SikaRoof VersiJack Wall Spacer shall be placed on top of SikaRoof VersiJack before placing stone, concrete or porcelain pavers abut to the wall spacer for all pavers along the perimeter of the raised flooring installation.
